title: 28. Forecast-Driven Cognition and Predictive Prefetching
summary: Defines Forecast-Driven Cognition (FDC) for GCS — a subsystem that predicts future cognitive requirements (intent, memory, experts, tools, nodes) and prepares resources in advance to reduce conversational and workflow latency.
notes: Classified as SPEC based on concrete implementation requirements (section 28.22), defined component interfaces (ACE, CES, GAML forecast-candidate/prefetch/commit interfaces), and architectural contracts spanning integration with GAML, EGGROLL, ELMs, and GNUS nodes. Lacks traditional SPEC hallmarks (endpoint tables, formal schemas, OpenAPI) — straddles DOC/SPEC boundary. Confidence set to medium.
